elements.name: Open Rent Owner Properties Click Photo and Scroll

steps.name: user launches the MagicBricks website
user hovers on Rent and clicks on Owner Properties under Popular Choices
user clicks on first property photo
user scrolls down the photo view page

elements.name: Contact Owner from Rent in that Owner Properties with valid data

steps.name: user launches the MagicBricks website
user hovers on Rent and clicks on Owner Properties under Popular Choices
user clicks on Contact Owner button
user fills the contact form with valid data from Excel
user clicks on Continue button
contact form should proceed next

elements.name: Contact Owner from Rent using sheet name and row

steps.name: user launches the MagicBricks website
user hovers on Rent and clicks on Owner Properties under Popular Choices
user clicks on Contact Owner button
user fills the contact form using sheet "Sheet1" and row 1
user clicks on Continue button
contact form should proceed next

elements.name: Contact Owner from Rent in Owner Properties with invalid WhatsApp number

steps.name: user launches the MagicBricks website
user hovers on Rent and clicks on Owner Properties under Popular Choices
user clicks on Contact Owner button
user fills the contact form with invalid WhatsApp number from Excel
user clicks on Continue button
phone number validation error message should appear

elements.name: Sort Owner Properties by Price High to Low

steps.name: user launches the MagicBricks website
user hovers on Rent and clicks on Owner Properties under Popular Choices
user selects Sort By as "Price: High to Low"
sorting should be applied

elements.name: Furnished Homes BHK Selection and Window Handling

steps.name: user launches the MagicBricks website
user hovers on Rent and clicks on Furnished Homes under Popular Choices
user scrolls to the bedroom selection section
user clicks on 1BHK option
the page should display only 1BHK furnished properties
